info.name: 🎮 Steam Data API — Complete
info.description:
# Steam Data API — Full Collection

A production-ready REST API for Steam game data. This collection covers **every** endpoint across all route groups.

---

## ⚡ Quick Setup

1. **Import** this file into Postman (`File → Import`)
2. Click the collection name → **Variables** tab
3. Set `baseUrl` to your server (default: `http://localhost:5000`)
4. Run **Register** or **Login** and copy the returned `token`
5. Paste the token into the `token` collection variable
6. All 🔐 protected requests will use it automatically via `Bearer {{token}}`

---

## 🗂 Folder Structure

| # | Folder | Mount Point | Count |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🎮 Games — CRUD | `/api/games` | 8 |
| 2 | 📁 Games — Sub-Resources | `/api/games/:appid/...` | 14 |
| 3 | 🏷️ Games — Filters | `/api/games/filter/...` | 15 |
| 4 | 📊 Games — Sort | `/api/games/sort/...` | 5 |
| 5 | 🔍 Games — Param Search | `/api/games/genre/:genre` etc | 9 |
| 6 | 🔎 Search | `/api/v1/search` | 1 |
| 7 | 🔐 Auth | `/api/v1/auth` | 9 |
| 8 | 🔑 JWT | `/api/v1/jwt` | 8 |
| 9 | 🛡️ Protected (JWT Write) | `/api/v1/protected` | 3 |
| 10 | 📈 Analytics | `/api/v1/analytics` | 10 |
| 11 | 📉 Stats | `/api/v1/stats` | 10 |
| 12 | 🚀 Advanced | `/api/v1` | 8 |
| 13 | 🛡️ Admin | `/api/v1/admin` | 3 |
| 14 | 🔔 Notifications | `/api/v1/notifications` | 3 |
| 15 | ⚙️ System | `/api/v1` | 3 |
| 16 | 🧪 Middleware Demo | `/api/v1/middleware` | 4 |
| 17 | 👤 Legacy Users | `/api/users` | 3 |

---

## 🔐 Authentication

```
POST /api/v1/auth/register  → create account
POST /api/v1/auth/login     → get token in response.data.token
```

Set the `token` variable, then every request marked 🔐 sends:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

item.name: 🎮 Games — CRUD
item.description:
Core game Create / Read / Update / Delete.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/games`

request.description: Fetch all non-deleted games. Supports pagination and filtering via query params.
Fetch a single game by its Steam appid.

body.raw:
{
  "appid": 9999001,
  "title": "My Test Game",
  "description": "A sample game created through the API for testing purposes.",
  "developer": "Test Studio",
  "publisher": "Test Publisher",
  "release_date": "2024-06-01",
  "genres": ["Action", "Indie"],
  "tags": ["Single-player", "Family Sharing"],
  "price": {
    "original": 14.99,
    "discounted": 9.99,
    "discount_percent": 33,
    "isFree": false
  },
  "rating": 8.5,
  "downloads": 25000,
  "platforms": {
    "windows": true,
    "mac": false,
    "linux": true
  },
  "isSingleplayer": true,
  "isIndie": true,
  "hasControllerSupport": true
}

request.description:
Create a new game.

**Required fields:** `title`, `appid` (positive integer)
**Optional:** `rating` must be 0–10, `price` ≥ 0, `release_date` must be ISO 8601

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Replaced Game Title",
  "developer": "New Developer Studio",
  "publisher": "New Publisher",
  "description": "Completely replaced document via PUT.",
  "genres": ["RPG", "Strategy"],
  "rating": 7.5,
  "downloads": 10000,
  "price": {
    "original": 19.99,
    "discounted": 19.99,
    "discount_percent": 0,
    "isFree": false
  }
}

request.description: Full replacement — replaces the entire document. Fields not provided will be reset to schema defaults.
Partial update — only fields provided are changed. Safe for single-field updates.

Permanently removes the game from the database. This cannot be undone.
For reversible deletion use PATCH /:appid/archive.
Sets `isDeleted: true`. Game is hidden from public listing but not removed from DB.
Restores a soft-deleted game. Sets `isDeleted: false`.
Returns `{ exists: true/false }` for the given appid.
Lightweight projection: title, rating, price, genres, platforms.
Games that share genres with this game, excluding itself.
Add a review. `score` must be 0–10.
Update review fields. Set `reviewId` collection variable first.
Removes a review subdocument by its MongoDB _id.
Returns top 10 games by rating as a leaderboard for this game's genre.
Returns 3 dynamically generated news articles based on the game's actual data.

item.name: 🏷️ Games — Filters
item.description:
Static boolean filter routes. All return paginated game lists.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/games/filter/...`

> These are registered BEFORE `/:appid` routes in Express to avoid path conflicts.

item.name: 🔍 Games — Param Search
item.description:
Find games by a specific attribute value.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/games/{attribute}/{value}`

request.description: Replace `Action` with any genre e.g. RPG, Indie, Strategy
Platform values: `windows`, `mac`, `linux`
Returns games with rating ≥ the given value (0–10)
Returns games priced ≤ the given value
Feature values: `coop`, `multiplayer`, `singleplayer`, `vr`, `controller`

item.name: 🔎 Search
item.description:
Full-text regex search across title, description, genres, tags, developer.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/search`

request.description: Full-text search. Searches across: `title`, `description`, `genres`, `tags`, `developer`, `publisher`.

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
Authentication flows.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth`

After login, copy `data.token` into the `token` collection variable.

request.description:
Create a new user account.

**Validation rules:**
- `email` — must be a valid email address
- `password` — minimum 6 characters, maximum 128 characters

Returns `data.token` on success.

Authenticate and receive a JWT.

Copy `data.token` from the response and paste it into the **`token`** collection variable.
Returns the authenticated user's profile. Requires valid JWT.
Returns a reset token in `data.resetToken` (in production this would be emailed).
Sends a one-time password. Returns `data.otpCode` in development mode.

item.name: 🔑 JWT
item.description:
JWT token management endpoints.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/jwt`

> ⚠️ All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`

request.description: Returns user data decoded directly from the JWT.
Returns a summary dashboard with user info and server timestamp.
Auth-gated mirror of GET /api/games. Supports all the same query params.
Auth-gated analytics: total/free/paid counts, avg rating, top genres, most-downloaded.
Verifies a JWT string and returns the decoded payload.
Issues a new token with a fresh expiry. Pass optional `expiresIn`.
Admin-only. Generates a custom JWT for any payload.
Adds the current Bearer token to an in-memory blacklist. Subsequent requests with this token will be rejected.

Auth-protected game write operations.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/protected`

> Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`
> Any logged-in user can access these (role: user or admin).

request.description: Top 10 games by rating.

Per-developer: game count + average rating.

Average, minimum, and maximum of price.original.

item.description:
Advanced game discovery and comparison endpoints.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1`

Top 10 games by downloads released in the last 90 days.

Game's updateHistory array in reverse-chronological order.
Last 20 request log entries from the in-memory ring buffer (method, url, statusCode, duration, timestamp).

item.name: 🛡️ Admin
item.description:
Admin-only endpoints.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/admin`

> Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` **AND** user must have `role: admin`

request.description: Returns ALL game documents including soft-deleted (isDeleted: true). Supports ?sort=rating|downloads|price|title|releaseDate|createdAt
Single `$facet` aggregation returning totalGames, activeGames, archivedGames, avgRating, avgPrice, platformDist, genreDist.
Summary report: { totalUsers, totalGames, activeGames, archivedGames, recentActivity }

item.name: 🔔 Notifications
item.description:
In-memory notification system. Resets on server restart.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/notifications`

Pre-seeded with 5 notifications on startup.

request.description: Returns all notifications newest-first with total count and unread count.
Sets `read: true` on the notification with the given id (integer). Replace `1` with the actual id.
Permanently removes the notification from memory. Replace `1` with actual id.

item.name: ⚙️ System
item.description:
System health and runtime information.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1`

request.description: Returns `{ status: 'ok', uptime: 'Xs', timestamp: ISO }`. Use for liveness probes.
Returns Node.js version, environment, platform, memory usage, and MongoDB connection status.
Returns `name`, `version`, `description` from package.json.
Root endpoint — quick liveness check outside the versioned API.

item.name: 🧪 Middleware Demo
item.description:
Demo endpoints that exercise each middleware layer.
Base: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/middleware`

Useful for testing rate limiting and error handling without affecting real data.

request.description:
Triggers `requestLogger`. Check the server console for the log line:
`[GET] /api/v1/middleware/logger - <timestamp> - Xms`
Tests the auth rate limiter (10 requests / 15 min per IP). After 10 hits you'll receive a 429.
Tests the general rate limiter (100 requests / 15 min per IP).
Simulates a Mongoose ValidationError → 400 response.
Simulates a Mongoose CastError → 400 response.
Simulates a MongoDB E11000 duplicate key error → 409 response.
Returns HTTP 418 I'm a Teapot via AppError.
No `?type=` param → falls through to the default 500 path.
